meta.homeTitle: Flower Story Boutique | Premium flower delivery in Rishon LeZion, Israel
meta.homeDescription: Flower Story is a premium flower boutique in Rishon LeZion: rose bouquets, balloon bouquets, dessert hearts and flower arrangements made to order and delivered across Israel. Order on WhatsApp.
meta.shopTitle: Shop | Bouquets, balloons & gift boxes – Flower Story
meta.shopDescription: All Flower Story bouquets, balloon bouquets, gift boxes and desserts. Choose size, colours and a personal message, delivered in Rishon LeZion and central Israel.

manifesto.title: A premium flower boutique, for a magical and moving bond between people
manifesto.body: Every order is built around the person receiving it: the colours, the size, the words. Rose bouquets, balloon bouquets, desserts and flower hearts, designed in our Rishon LeZion studio and delivered in Israel, with event work abroad too.

items.title: Rose bouquets
items.text: Dozens, even hundreds of roses in a single bouquet, wrapped in soft layers. A gesture no one forgets.

items.title: Balloon bouquets
items.text: Choose the balloon colour, the wrap and the size, then add a personal word printed on the balloon.

items.title: Dessert & flower boxes
items.text: Hearts filled with desserts and dressed with fresh flowers. Sweet, beautiful and festive.

shop.title: Choose the moment
shop.intro: Every bouquet is made on the day of delivery. Pick the size, the colours and the message; we take care of the rest.

statement.title: Nothing quite like it
statement.text: Our new flower heart: festive, elegant and made for life’s big moments.
statement.alt: A heart of pink flowers in a basket with a heart-shaped handle

story.title: Behind every bouquet, there is Shir
story.body: Flower Story was born from a love of that moment when someone receives flowers and can’t quite believe it. In her Rishon LeZion studio, Shir designs every order around the person receiving it, from a giant rose bouquet to a small dessert heart with a message.
story.alt: Shir, founder of Flower Story, holding a pink flower heart

events.title: Flowers for the big moments
events.text: Flowers and balloons for events in Israel and abroad, and flower workshops for groups. Tell us about your event and we’ll come back with a proposal.

upclose.title: The small details
upclose.text: Pearls among the roses, layered organza, ribbons tied by hand. The things you only see up close.
upclose.alt: A close-up detail of a bouquet

items.title: Delivery
items.text: We deliver in Rishon LeZion and the surrounding area, and across Israel on request.

items.title: Opening days
items.text: Sunday to Friday. No deliveries on Shabbat or Jewish holidays.

items.title: Order ahead
items.text: We recommend ordering a day ahead. For holidays and limited editions, as early as you can.

items.title: Pick-up
items.text: You can collect your order at our Rishon LeZion studio by appointment.

contact.title: Let’s talk flowers
contact.text: WhatsApp is the fastest way to reach us. Shir replies Sunday to Friday.
